metadataRaw.title: How to Crack Your Wrists by Yourself
metadataRaw.description:
In this video, Dr. Rowe shows how to crack your wrists by yourself in an EASY, step-by-step guide.

This self adjust technique is great for putting more motion in and around the wrist, including the carpal bones that are common associated with carpal tunnel syndrome. 

If you are suffering from carpal tunnel syndrome (or median nerve impingement), this will help self mobilize the lunate bone, which may offer INSTANT relief.

Also, it may also help with POP, CRACK, SNAP, or CLICK sounds coming from wrist movement. So, if you're looking for a quick way to improve range of motion in the wrists, and help decrease wrist stiffness and achy pain... you're not going to want to miss out on this one!

WATCH now and get those wrists feeling better!
